snippet.title: The Disappearance of Emily Crowe – Official Gameplay Trailer | Psychological Horror
snippet.description:
Wishlist The Disappearance of Emily Crowe on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3206780/The_Disappearance_of_Emily_Crowe/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=gameplay_trailer&utm_content=description

Play the free demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4680400/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=gameplay_trailer&utm_content=description

Your sister Emily disappeared 15 years ago. Now something has drawn you back to the house, the forest, and the memories you left behind.

The Disappearance of Emily Crowe is a first-person psychological horror game where survival is about learning what hunts you.

Use your real phone as an optional companion to reveal things your PC screen can't see — hidden weaknesses, supernatural barriers, entities and clues buried in the environment.

Five creatures haunt this place, and each one follows different rules. Learn how they hunt, hide when you can, and uncover what really happened to Emily.

Coming to Steam October 26, 2026.
Wishlist now and play the free demo.

Developed by Nemoris Games.
